_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::ehl#0, and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The entry claimed an incompatible lubrication/structure interface 'raises no matching lubrication interface from 4C_ehl_factory.cpp at setup'. On upstream ehl3d_mixed.4C.yaml neither breakage says anything: giving the Master side InterfaceID 2 while the Slave keeps 1 is accepted and still reproduces all seven reference values (IDMISMATCH_PASSED_TESTS=7), and deleting the Master condition outright still runs to the end with the contact node collapsing to ~1e-15 in x, caught only by the deck's own result tests (5 of 7). CLAIMED_NO_MATCHING_TEXT=00 concatenates the counts from both broken arms; no 4C_ehl_factory.cpp exists in 4C. Both are silent-wrong failures. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).
